answer: Operator-Linked Identity Quota. Each wallet declares a durable operator key at registration; the protocol caps live identities per operator using a cedar-indexed quota ledger. New identities beyond the cap require the operator to post a crystal deposit that is forfeited to the treasury upon any confirmed duplicate-operator link. An echo audit replays registration proofs and freezes the operator's entire quota until resolution. Cost: every extra identity risks the operator's full deposit and blocks all their existing wallets.
